import java.util.*;

public class MaxFlowSolver {
    static Map<Integer, Integer>[] adj = new HashMap[7000];
    static char[][] grid_map = new char[20][20];
    static int N, M, total_vertices, target_map[][] = new int[10][10];
    static int[] parent_nodes = new int[7000], flow_vals = new int[7000];
    static final int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7000; i++) {
            adj[i] = new HashMap<>();
        }
    }

    static int maxFlow(int s, int t, int cap) {
        int total_flow = 0;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(parent_nodes, -1);
            parent_nodes[s] = s;
            flow_vals[s] = cap;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            boolean foundPath = false;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == t) {
                    int v = t;
                    int flow = flow_vals[t];
                    for (; v != s; v = parent_nodes[v]) {
                        int u2 = parent_nodes[v];
                        adj[u2].put(v, adj[u2].getOrDefault(v, 0) - flow);
                        adj[v].put(u2, adj[v].getOrDefault(u2, 0) + flow);
                    }
                    total_flow += flow;
                    foundPath = true;
                    break;
                }
                for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> it : adj[u].entrySet()) {
                    int v = it.getKey();
                    int capacity = it.getValue();
                    if (capacity >= cap && parent_nodes[v] == -1) {
                        parent_nodes[v] = u;
                        flow_vals[v] = Math.min(capacity, flow_vals[u]);
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!foundPath) break;
        }
        return total_flow;
    }

    static int encode(int x, int y, int t) {
        return x + y * N + t * N * N + 2;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        M = sc.nextInt();

        int total_res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                grid_map[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (grid_map[i][j] > '0' && grid_map[i][j] <= '9') {
                    adj[0].put(encode(i, j, 0), grid_map[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                grid_map[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
                target_map[i][j] = M + 1;
            }
        }

        Queue<int[]> q_bfs = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = N - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = N - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                if (grid_map[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    target_map[i][j] = 0;
                    q_bfs.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }

        while (!q_bfs.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q_bfs.poll();
            int i = p[0], j = p[1];
            for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; dir++) {
                int t = target_map[i][j];
                int x = i + dx[dir], y = j + dy[dir];
                if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < N && y < N && grid_map[x][y] != 'Y' && t + 1 < target_map[x][y]) {
                    target_map[x][y] = t + 1;
                    q_bfs.offer(new int[]{x, y});
                }
            }
        }

        total_vertices = encode(N - 1, N - 1, M) + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                for (int t = 0; t < M; t++) {
                    if (t < M) {
                        for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++) {
                            int x = i + dx[q], y = j + dy[q];
                            if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < N && y < N && grid_map[x][y] != 'Y') {
                                int t_next = t + 1;
                                int t_target = target_map[x][y] + (grid_map[x][y] > '0' && grid_map[x][y] <= '9' ? 1 : 0);
                                if (t_next < t_target && t < target_map[i][j]) {
                                    adj[encode(i, j, t)].put(encode(x, y, t_next), 1000);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (grid_map[i][j] > '0' && grid_map[i][j] <= '9') {
                            int capacity = grid_map[i][j] - '0';
                            adj[encode(i, j, t)].put(encode(i, j, M), capacity);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (grid_map[i][j] > '0' && grid_map[i][j] <= '9') {
                    int capacity = grid_map[i][j] - '0';
                    adj[encode(i, j, M)].put(1, capacity);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int u = 8; u > 0; u /= 2) {
            total_res += maxFlow(0, 1, u);
        }
        System.out.println(total_res);
        sc.close();
    }
}
